title: Totem Man
description: This resourcepack chages the texture of the totem of undying.
body:
This resource pack replaces the normal totem texture with a custom one.
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/950cbcc0a476242ce916ca49b657dacd42792c72.png)
The custom totem image was made on Blockbench. The image is:![A totem man](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f36a2a17e789db0c76de6c62cfc7aff7bd6b29f1.png)

This totem is just a normal one, textured as a man but keeping the totem aesthetic.

Resourcepack generated with
